# 2Hands Massage Academy

> 2Hands is a bilingual hospitality performance partner based in Casablanca, Morocco. Founder Brooke Wescott brings more than 25 years of international hands-on massage and bodywork experience. She helps hotels, resorts, riads and professional spas assess massage quality, develop spa teams, create signature treatments and maintain consistent guest-experience standards.

French is the website's default language. English pages are available under `/en/`. 2Hands works primarily in Casablanca, Rabat and nearby regions, with selected projects elsewhere in Morocco and internationally.

## Hospitality services

- [Services hôtellerie et spa — français](https://2handsacademy.com/services/): Overview of the four hospitality pathways.
- [Hospitality and spa services — English](https://2handsacademy.com/en/services/): English overview of the four hospitality pathways.
- [Diagnostic de performance de l'équipe spa](https://2handsacademy.com/services/diagnostic/): Technical assessment and development priorities for spa teams.
- [Spa Team Performance Assessment](https://2handsacademy.com/en/services/assessment/): English assessment information.
- [Formation ciblée des équipes spa](https://2handsacademy.com/services/formation-equipe/): Practical, on-site team development.
- [Spa team training](https://2handsacademy.com/en/services/team-training/): English team-training information.
- [Création de soins signature](https://2handsacademy.com/services/soin-signature/): Treatment concept, protocol and team transfer.
- [Signature treatment development](https://2handsacademy.com/en/services/signature-treatment/): English signature-treatment information.
- [Accompagnement et continuité](https://2handsacademy.com/services/accompagnement/): Reassessment, recalibration and management support.
- [Ongoing support](https://2handsacademy.com/en/services/ongoing-support/): English ongoing-support information.
